proposals.quote: The Board also notes positively that HRMP is the only Applicant proposing onsite daycare and tuition reimbursement.
2) HRMP commits to offer tuition reimbursement through its Continuing Education Assistance Program, providing up to $4,000 annually for work-related courses and degree programs.
3) HRMP will have an on-site child day care program for employees with children from three months to 12 years old.
The indoor area will be 14,267 square feet, accommodating up to 160 children for daycare and 108 children for after school.
There will be two nursery rooms, a toddler room, six classrooms, sleeping rooms for overnight care, and two classrooms for children with special needs and sensory issues.
There will also be an outdoor space of 3,000 square feet. The entire facility will be ADA-accessible and open 24/7.
